coverLetter:
Maya Linden
Portland, OR, USA
maya.linden@example.com
+1 555 0142

October 12, 2026

Hiring Manager
Coinbase

Dear Hiring Manager,

Your events have to bring the Coinbase brand to life for both Consumer and Institutional audiences, and every one of them has to turn strangers into people who show up. I've worked on that problem at a smaller scale. As Social Media Lead for the Westbrook Film Society, I raised average screening attendance from 35 to 60 tickets per event with a weekly "pick of the week" reel.

I'm early in my career, and I won't pretend otherwise: I haven't yet owned an event end to end or worked with Splash or Cvent. What I have done is help plan a weekend adoption event at Harbor Street Pet Supply that brought in about 300 visitors, and I wrote and scheduled a newsletter every week in Mailchimp. I build content in Canva and CapCut, and I read results in Google Analytics and Instagram Insights, so the engagement metrics and attendance data behind your post-event reporting are familiar ground. I also trained two new volunteers at the society, which taught me to coordinate people who have their own priorities.

A remote-first team that meets for quarterly "surges" suits how I like to work: independent, then fully in the room. I'd welcome a conversation about how I could support your experiential calendar, and I'm available to start whenever works for your team.

Best regards,
Maya Linden
